calendar.description: Calendar specialist: use for managing calendar events. Handles files with .ics extension. Can create events, list events, and delete events. Choose this agent when the task involves scheduling meetings or managing calendar entries.

skills.name: Create Event
skills.description: create a new event to a user's calendar

skills.name: List Events
skills.description: list all events from a user's calendar

skills.name: Delete Event
skills.description: delete an event from a user's calendar

excel.description: Excel specialist: use for spreadsheet operations. Can create workbooks, read/write cells, format sheets, and convert to PDF. Choose this agent for data manipulation, calculations, or Excel document creation.

skills.name: Read Cell
skills.description: read a cell value from an Excel file

skills.name: Write Cell
skills.description: write a value to an Excel cell

shell.description: Shell specialist: use for executing system commands and bash operations. Can run commands, navigate directories, manage and find files. Choose this agent if a task requires accessing a file or executing system commands.

skills.name: Execute Command
skills.description: Execute a bash/shell command. Files for tasks are located in /testbed/data. If filenames are unknown, list the directory and search to locate relevant files.

word.description: Word specialist: use for creating and editing Word documents. Can create new files, read Word files, write text into Word files, and convert Word to PDF. Choose this agent for drafting documents, formatting text content, or producing a PDF from Word.

skills.name: Read File
skills.description: read the content of a Word file

skills.name: Write To File
skills.description: write text to a Word file

email.description: Email specialist: use for email workflows. Handle files with .eml extension. Can list emails, read specific emails, and send emails. Choose this agent when the task involves communication, replying/summarizing messages, or sending results via email.

skills.name: Send Email
skills.description: send an email to a recipient

skills.name: List Emails
skills.description: list emails for a given username

skills.name: Read Email
skills.description: read a user's email by the given Email ID

llm.description: LLM tool specialist: use for pure text transformation tasks via the 'llm' app (complete_text). Choose this agent when you need rewriting, summarization, classification, or generating text that does not require other apps/tools.

skills.name: Complete Text
skills.description: query an LLM model for an answer to a given prompt

ocr.description: OCR specialist: use to extract text from images or scanned documents. Can run OCR on a file (recognize_file). Choose this agent when the input is an image/PDF page screenshot/scan and text must be recognized before further processing.

skills.name: Recognize File
skills.description: recognize the text from an image file

pdf.description: PDF specialist: use for PDF reading and conversion. Can read PDF files, convert PDFs to images, and convert PDFs to Word documents. Choose this agent when the task involves extracting content from PDFs or converting PDFs into editable formats.

skills.name: Convert To Image
skills.description: convert a pdf file to an image file

skills.name: Convert To Word
skills.description: convert a pdf file to a word file
